_doc: Tester missions, generated by docs/testing/tester_missions.py from the demo manifests, known-demos.json and its list of functions. A mission names a goal, never the steps: testers use the user documentation and the RasQberry helper. group: one of groups; needs: what a tester must have, as keys of needs_keys, so the tester helper can match missions to a tester's setup; maturity beta: early beta, not yet tested by people; part: one part of a demo (a variant of its manifest); status coming: not in the images yet.

needs_keys.ab-image: A/B image on a 64 GB card or larger
needs_keys.big-card: SD card of 32 GB or more

missions.title: First start
missions.goal: Install RasQberry with Raspberry Pi Imager, with your own user name, password and Wi-Fi, and reach the desktop.

missions.title: Setup Checklist
missions.goal: Go through the Setup Checklist until its icon leaves the desktop: do each step, or skip it.

missions.title: Desktop folders and menu
missions.goal: Find each demo through its desktop folder and through the RasQberry menu.

missions.title: Wi-Fi
missions.goal: Join a Wi-Fi network, and see the Pi come back after the router restarts.

missions.title: Update to a new release
missions.goal: Install a release into the other system (a newer one, or the same again), start it, and go back.

missions.title: Slot icon and What's new
missions.goal: Use the slot icon in the taskbar and read What's new after an update.

missions.title: Help and feedback
missions.goal: Get help for a problem from the Pi: System Info, the helper and the website.

missions.title: Download all demos
missions.goal: Download all demos, then start a few without internet.

missions.title: Demo Loop
missions.goal: Run the Demo Loop with demos of your choice, and let it start at login.

missions.title: Learning paths
missions.goal: Follow one learning path from start to end.

missions.title: My Quantum Programs
missions.goal: Write and run your own quantum program in My Quantum Programs.

missions.title: IBM Quantum account
missions.goal: Save your IBM Quantum API key and run a demo on a real quantum computer.

missions.title: Add and remove a demo
missions.goal: Add a demo from the catalogue, start it, and remove it again.

missions.title: LED views without a panel
missions.goal: Watch an LED demo in the on-screen view and in the browser view.

missions.title: Touchscreen
missions.goal: Use the Pi by touch only: touch mode and the on-screen keyboard.

missions.title: LED panel setup
missions.goal: Set up the LED panel: find its layout, check it, and set the brightness.

missions.title: Sound on a Bluetooth speaker
missions.goal: Pair a Bluetooth speaker and calibrate the sound delay until tick and LED flash come together.

missions.title: Remote access
missions.goal: Reach the Pi from another computer: SSH, VNC and Raspberry Pi Connect.

missions.title: Wi-Fi hotspot
missions.goal: Let phones and laptops join the Pi's own Wi-Fi and open its demos.

missions.title: Updates on the single-system image
missions.goal: Check for a newer image on the single-system image and follow what the Pi suggests.

missions.title: LED Demos
missions.goal: Try the LED demos: text, logos and colour effects on the LED panel.

missions.title: LED-Painter
missions.goal: Paint a picture and show it on the LED panel.

missions.title: Quantum Lights Out
missions.goal: Watch Grover's search solve Lights Out, on the LED panel and in the console.

missions.title: Quantum Raspberry Tie
missions.goal: Show measured qubits on the LED panel, from the simulator or, with an IBM Quantum account, a real quantum computer.

missions.title: RasQ-LED Demo
missions.goal: Show superposition and entanglement on the LED panel.

missions.title: Entangible
missions.goal: Build a circuit with the printed gate tiles and let the camera read it.

missions.title: Qoffee-Maker
missions.goal: Order a coffee from a quantum computer, with or without a Home Connect machine.

missions.title: Quantum Mixer
missions.goal: Mix a cocktail, an ice cream or a coffee with a quantum circuit.

missions.title: racetraQ
missions.goal: Race a car steered by a quantum agent and train your own.

missions.title: Fun with Quantum: start here
missions.goal: Open the Fun with Quantum start page and pick a game from it.

missions.title: Fun with Quantum: Quantum Coin Game
missions.goal: Play the Quantum Coin Game, first classically, then with the quantum H move.

missions.title: Fun with Quantum: GHZ Game
missions.goal: Play the GHZ Game and see how quantum players win.

missions.title: Fun with Quantum: Hardy's Paradox
missions.goal: Work through Hardy's Paradox.

missions.title: Fun with Quantum: Mermin–Peres Magic Square
missions.goal: Play the Mermin–Peres Magic Square.

missions.title: Fun with Quantum: 3-SAT with Grover's Algorithm
missions.goal: Solve a 3-SAT problem with Grover's algorithm.

missions.title: Fun with Quantum: The CHSH Game
missions.goal: Play the CHSH Game.

missions.title: Fun with Quantum: The Quantum Prisoner's Dilemma
missions.goal: Play the Quantum Prisoner's Dilemma.

missions.title: Fun with Quantum: GHZ on Real Quantum Devices
missions.goal: Run the GHZ experiment on a real quantum computer.

missions.title: Fun with Quantum website: games in the browser
missions.goal: Play the games in the browser on the Fun with Quantum website, also offline.

missions.title: Fun with Quantum family: related projects
missions.goal: Explore the other projects of the Fun with Quantum family.

missions.title: Quantum Fractals
missions.goal: Watch the fractals change with the state of a qubit.

missions.title: Quantum Paradoxes
missions.goal: Work through one of the quantum paradox notebooks.

missions.title: Grokking the Bloch Sphere
missions.goal: Move a qubit around the Bloch sphere and follow the gates.

missions.title: Grokking the Bloch Sphere: online version
missions.goal: Open the online version from the Pi and move a qubit around the Bloch sphere.

missions.title: Qiskit Tutorials on this Pi
missions.goal: Open a tutorial in Qiskit Tutorials on this Pi and run its code.

missions.title: QuBins
missions.goal: Choose a Qiskit version and the notebooks, start QuBins and run a notebook.

missions.title: IBM Quantum Composer
missions.goal: Build a circuit in the IBM Quantum Composer and simulate it.

missions.title: IBM Quantum Courses
missions.goal: Open an IBM Quantum course and run its first code cells.

missions.title: IBM Quantum Tutorials
missions.goal: Open an IBM Quantum tutorial and run its code cells.

missions.title: Qiskit Live (QuBins)
missions.goal: Start the Qiskit Live and run a notebook.

missions.title: SAP Quantum Learning
missions.goal: Take the quiz and build a circuit in SAP Quantum Learning.

missions.title: SAP Quantum LED
missions.goal: Show the SAP logo on the LED panel, coloured by three qubits.
